# Fixed synthetic V1 history verifier fixtures

These 38 complete bundles were generated solely from the 34 fixed original
V1 schema profiles, fixed old target20 schema and synthetic typed histories.
No installed-program files, live-user SQLite files, credentials or sessions
are used. SQLite tests open only freshly owned copies of the fixture bytes.

The 34 schema cases and rich-desktop, rich-tenant, rich-daemon, rich-parent
bundles preserve exact rows, original IDs, mapping and preview pins. Tests
locate this directory relative to CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR without environment or
network dependencies. The crate fixture-surface.json lists every file SHA,
size and bundle count. Runtime or live-commit authority cannot be derived
from these historical target20 preview fixtures.
